title: The Radiators of the reservoir
author: August Halloran
blurb: Dominic Vasquez, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
